title: Greek Prose Style and Rhetoric
objectives: Analyze rhetorical structures in Greek prose
Identify figures of speech (anaphora, chiasmus, etc.)
Recognize differences between Attic and Koine style

grammar.explanation: Greek rhetoric was highly developed, influencing all subsequent Western literature. Orators like Demosthenes and Isocrates created models of style that persisted through the Hellenistic period and into Koine.

readingPassage.greek: Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὁ λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν θεόν, καὶ θεὸς ἦν ὁ λόγος. οὗτος ἦν ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν θεόν.
readingPassage.analysis: Chiastic structure: ἐν ἀρχῇ...λόγος...θεόν / θεὸς...λόγος...ἐν ἀρχῇ. Anaphora of καί creates rhythmic parallelism. λόγος bridges Greek philosophical and Hebrew wisdom traditions.

exercises.question: Identify the rhetorical structure in the Prologue of John
